supersessions.evidence: ADR-0043 says it defines folders/project names/solution organization and ADR-0002 remains architecture authority. This creates partial supersession of examples, not decisions.

supersessions.resolution: Defined shared lifecycle state metadata and allowed transitions in RFC-0027 and SPEC-0001. Direct extraction-to-publication assumptions are superseded by explicit promotion and publication states.

supersessions.evidence: DR-0004 accepted Option B. SPEC-0001 now distinguishes documentation prototype, package source, packaged artifact, and installed artifact roles.
supersessions.resolution: Documentation prototypes are review and authoring evidence only. Progression to package source, packaged artifact, and installed artifact requires explicit transformation, identity preservation, fingerprints, validation, reconciliation, and accepted evidence.
